address: 55, Section 7, Zhongshan North Road, Shilin District, Taipei, 111, Taiwan
bio: Since 1987, this joint has been popular for get-togethers among family and friends on account of its remarkable traditional Taiwanese fare. With an array of both home-style dishes and banquet classics, the menu features sharing plates and comforting staples that deliver big flavours. Try signatures such as boiled free-range chicken, and Buddha Jumps Over The Wall. Taiwan-style ice lollies at the end of the meal are the icing on the cake.
